interface.shortDescription: From idea to delivered app｜從想法到應用交付
interface.longDescription: Turn a work problem, learning goal, or everyday-life idea into a real application—not just an AI conversation. EW AI Coding guides people without a software background from a focused blueprint and five consistent Codex-ready files through GitHub project history, staged Codex development, automated testing, user preview, acceptance fixes, explicitly authorized release, and evidence-based value verification. It supports Web, Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone/iPad, and multi-platform delivery while increasing governance only for shared access, sensitive data, irreversible actions, or physical-world implementation. 把工作問題、學習目標或生活構想變成真正能運作的應用，而不只是一段 AI 對話。EW AI Coding 引導不會寫程式的人完成五份一致規格、GitHub 建檔、Codex 分階段開發、自動測試、使用者預覽、驗收修正、明確授權發布與價值驗證，並支援 Web、Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iPhone/iPad 與多平台交付。

請幫我把工作、學習或生活中的想法，整理成可開發、可驗收的應用，再交給 Codex。
